title: Lemon
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="lemonGrad" cx="40%" cy="35%" r="60%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFF176"/>
      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#FFEB3B"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#F9A825"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="cutGrad" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFF9C4"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#FFF176"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FDD835"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Whole lemon body -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="56" rx="30" ry="24" fill="url(#lemonGrad)" transform="rotate(-15 48 56)"/>

  <!-- Lemon highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="46" rx="10" ry="7" fill="#FFF9C4" opacity="0.6" transform="rotate(-15 38 46)"/>

  <!-- Nub top -->
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="33" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#F9A825" transform="rotate(-15 52 33)"/>

  <!-- Nub bottom -->
  <ellipse cx="44" cy="78" rx="5" ry="3.5" fill="#F9A825" transform="rotate(-15 44 78)"/>

  <!-- Cut lemon half -->
  <g transform="translate(72, 48) rotate(10)">
    <!-- Rind -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="17" fill="#F9A825"/>
    <!-- Pith -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="15" fill="#FFF9C4"/>
    <!-- Flesh -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="12.5" fill="url(#cutGrad)"/>

    <!-- Segments -->
    <line x1="0" y1="-1" x2="0" y2="-11" stroke="#FDD835" stroke-width="1.2" opacity="0.7"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="1" x2="0" y2="11" stroke="#FDD835" stroke-width="1.2" opacity="0.7"/>
    <line x1="-1" y1="0" x2="-11" y2="0" stroke="#FDD835" stroke-width="1.2" opacity="0.7"/>
    <line x1="1" y1="0" x2="11" y2="0" stroke="#FDD835" stroke-width="1.2" opacity="0.7"/>
    <line x1="0.7" y1="-0.7" x2="7.8" y2="-7.8" stroke="#FDD835" stroke-width="1.2" opacity="0.7"/>
    <line x1="-0.7" y1="-0.7" x2="-7.8" y2="-7.8" stroke="#FDD835" stroke-width="1.2" opacity="0.7"/>
    <line x1="0.7" y1="0.7" x2="7.8" y2="7.8" stroke="#FDD835" stroke-width="1.2" opacity="0.7"/>
    <line x1="-0.7" y1="0.7" x2="-7.8" y2="7.8" stroke="#FDD835" stroke-width="1.2" opacity="0.7"/>

    <!-- Center pip -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="1.5" fill="#FFF9C4"/>

    <!-- Shine on cut face -->
    <ellipse cx="-6" cy="-6" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.4"/>
  </g>
</svg>
